name: bighead
description: A personal second brain for Claude Code + Obsidian, built on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern: immutable raw sources, an LLM-maintained wiki, and a schema file.

vault_path.title: Vault folder
vault_path.description: Optional. Your vault's folder. Set it to use the vault from other project folders: sessions there get a pointer to the matching project hub, and the project, save, handoff, playbook, query, ingest and research-deep skills work there. Leave empty to use the kit only inside the vault.
